# Not Broken ADHD

> A free, independent, plain-language ADHD resource (also titled "The ADHD Field Guide"): the science of ADHD, signs and red flags, a private self-check, focus and coping strategies, a full medication guide with pros and cons, and help talking to a doctor. Available in English, Arabic, Hebrew and Hungarian. Educational only, not medical advice.

Built by someone who lived through a late ADHD diagnosis, and kept anonymous on purpose. No sign-up is needed to read anything. Contact: notbrokenadhd@gmail.com

## Main guide

- [The ADHD Field Guide (English)](https://notbrokenadhd.com/): A plain-language ADHD guide: the science, signs, a self-check, focus tools and a full medication guide with pros and cons. Educational, not medical advice.
- [الدليل الشامل لـ ADHD (Arabic)](https://notbrokenadhd.com/ar): مورد بلغة مبسطة عن اضطراب نقص الانتباه وفرط الحركة: العلم، العلامات، اختبار ذاتي، أدوات التركيز، ودليل أدوية شامل. للتثقيف فقط — ليس نصيحة طبية.
- [המדריך המלא ל-ADHD (Hebrew)](https://notbrokenadhd.com/he): משאב בשפה פשוטה על הפרעת קשב, ריכוז והיפראקטיביות: המדע, הסימנים, בדיקה עצמית, כלי מיקוד, ומדריך תרופות מקיף. למטרות חינוך בלבד — לא ייעוץ רפואי.
- [Az ADHD Terepkalauz (Hungarian)](https://notbrokenadhd.com/hu): Közérthető ADHD-forrás: a tudomány, a jelek, a vészjelek, egy önteszt, fókusz-eszközök és teljes gyógyszer-útmutató. Csak oktatás — nem orvosi tanács.

## Articles (English)

- [Active Recall & Spaced Repetition for ADHD](https://notbrokenadhd.com/active-recall-spaced-repetition-adhd): Active recall and spaced repetition are the two most effective study techniques in the research, and they suit ADHD brains especially well. Here’s how.
- [ADHD and Exams: How to Revise and Cope](https://notbrokenadhd.com/adhd-and-exams): Revising for exams with ADHD is hard, but not impossible. Evidence-based strategies for studying, handling exam stress, and getting the accommodations you need.
- [ADHD and sleep: why it’s so hard, and what actually helps](https://notbrokenadhd.com/adhd-and-sleep): Sleep problems are extremely common with ADHD. Here’s why the ADHD brain resists sleep — and practical, evidence-informed ways to sleep better.
- [How to thrive with ADHD at work](https://notbrokenadhd.com/adhd-at-work): Practical, judgement-free strategies for ADHD at work — from beating task paralysis and deadlines to accommodations and playing to your strengths.
- [ADHD in women and girls: why it’s so often missed](https://notbrokenadhd.com/adhd-in-women): ADHD is widely under-diagnosed in women and girls. Here’s how it really presents, why it gets overlooked, and what to do about a late diagnosis.
- [How to Get an ADHD Diagnosis as an Adult: Criteria and Steps](https://notbrokenadhd.com/how-to-get-an-adhd-diagnosis): How to get an ADHD diagnosis as an adult: the diagnostic criteria in plain language, the assessment step by step, what to bring, and how to choose an assessor.
- [How to Study with ADHD: 10 Strategies That Actually Work](https://notbrokenadhd.com/how-to-study-with-adhd): Studying with ADHD isn’t a willpower problem. 10 evidence-based study strategies (active recall, spaced repetition, timed focus) that work with your brain.

## Articles (Arabic and Hebrew only)

- [كونسيرتا وريتالين (ميثيلفينيديت): دليل مبسّط](https://notbrokenadhd.com/methylphenidate-concerta-ritalin-ar): Arabic guide to methylphenidate (Concerta, Ritalin): differences, onset, correct use, side effects, when to seek help.
- [أعراض تشتت الانتباه عند الكبار: علامات ADHD في الحياة اليومية](https://notbrokenadhd.com/adhd-symptoms-in-adults-ar): Arabic guide to adult ADHD symptoms: inattention, adult hyperactivity and impulsivity, emotional signs, ADHD vs everyday distraction, look-alike conditions, when to see a doctor in Saudi Arabia.
- [ריטלין וקונצרטה (מתילפנידט): מדריך בשפה פשוטה](https://notbrokenadhd.com/methylphenidate-concerta-ritalin-he): Hebrew guide to methylphenidate (Ritalin, Ritalin LA, Concerta, Phenidin) for Israeli readers: differences and duration, onset, correct use, side effects, when to seek help, prescribing and the health basket in Israel.

## Translations

Each article is also available in other languages by adding a suffix to the URL: `-ar` (Arabic), `-he` (Hebrew), `-hu` (Hungarian where available). Examples:

- [كيف تزدهر مع ADHD في العمل](https://notbrokenadhd.com/adhd-at-work-ar)
- [איך לשגשג עם ADHD בעבודה](https://notbrokenadhd.com/adhd-at-work-he)
- [Hogyan boldogulj ADHD-val a munkában](https://notbrokenadhd.com/adhd-at-work-hu)
